|errata_history=Versions of [[Attark (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 8: Jabba's Court]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Attark (V) (Virtual Set 8)]]): release sheet “Virtual Set #8” (Players Committee; released 24 November 2004; PDF dated 24 November 2004), page 1, slip 1 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20041205113015/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/VirtualSet8Final.pdf VirtualSet8Final.pdf on swccgpc.com] (Internet Archive capture of 5 December 2004), announced in the [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Committee's news post of 24 November 2004]: “When No Love For The Empire on table, once during your control phase you may retrieve a non-unique alien of a different species than your Rep.” Stats line: “POWER 2 ABILITY 2”. Deploy 2, forfeit 3. The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “8•1” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071026143738/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards8.pdf Internet Archive capture of 26 October 2007; later 2007 re-edits included], slip 1), in the Committee's Remaster template: “During your control phase, if No Love For The Empire on table, may retrieve a non-unique alien of a different species than your Rep.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here). This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
